```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
email <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/roualdes/data/master/email.csv")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = email, aes(spam)) +
  geom_bar()
```

## Two Sided

```{r}
phat <- mean(email$spam)
n <- length(email$spam)
s <- sd(email$spam)
alpha <- 0.02 # two sided

se <- s / sqrt(n)
t.star <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, df = n - 1)
me <- se * t.star
c(phat - me, phat + me)
```

## One Sided Upper

```{r}
phat <- mean(email$spam)
n <- length(email$spam)
s <- sd(email$spam)
alpha <- 0.02 # two sided

se <- s / sqrt(n)
t.star <- qt(1 - alpha, df = n - 1)
me <- se * t.star
c(phat - me, Inf)
```

## Mean Chars per Email

```{r}
mean(email$num_char)
```
